name: One&Only The Palm Dubai
positioning: Andalusian-style beach resort with a private beach and gardens on The Palm island, looking out to Dubai's skyline
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet private-beach base in Dubai
Couples looking for a calm, garden-set resort with butler help

facts.text: The resort is a beach resort on Dubai's Palm 'riviera'.
The resort sits on The Palm island, on West Crescent, Palm Jumeirah.
The architecture is Andalusian, complemented by lush gardens.
The resort has a private beach.
A palm-covered oasis surrounds the hotel, giving it a serene, protected feel.
Rooms have an in-room Nespresso machine and a Bose speaker and dock system.
The resort can assist guests with Dubai visa applications.
The resort received EarthCheck Gold Certification in 2026.

highlights.text: The resort's secluded beach looks out on Dubai's skyline.
The beach never feels crowded, and daybeds are almost always available at the pools.
Bathrooms are spacious and stocked with full-size Acqua di Parma products.
Butlers book restaurants, arrange spa visits and plan day trips for guests.

considerations.text: Dubai International Airport is about a 45-minute drive; the resort can arrange luxury transfers.
WhataHotel notes ultra-premium pricing that reflects the resort's luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes limited availability due to high demand.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: One&Only The Palm review
